calibration.method: Dark tick raster centers read independently. Frequency ticks all separated by 53 px; baseline center y362.5. Marker centroids from connected white interiors threshold R,G,B>200 in panel C, after identifying colors visually; overlapped points read from remaining perimeter.

uncertainty_method: Conservative interval combines marker y half-width plus 0.5 px origin error and scale interval 10.55..10.65 px/Hz; floor at physical nonnegative firing. These bounds are figure reading bounds, not CI or SEM.
